answer: Coordination-priced key issuance makes every agent identity carry a unique falcon reference tied to a timing window. An agent joining the grove must pay a fee equal to the median coordination cost of all identities registered in that same window. A reusable pigment marker embeds the window cost in each key, so mass registration inflates the price for every copy. An attacker's per-identity cost rises with the square of batch size, making thousands of sybils cost far more than marginal value.
